title: SBI Tata Neu Plus (Rupay) credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: A Tata Neu Plus (Rupay) card from SBI offering accelerated NeuCoins across Tata brands, unlimited airport lounge access, milestone vouchers, travel and lifestyle perks, designed for loyal Tata ecosystem users with perks of Rupay Networks.

eligibility: spend ₹50,000 or more in the previous calendar quarter
